summary: Full backend + frontend review for 无限量化 MetaTrader marketing site. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass. All key frontend flows (hero canvas, nav anchors, i18n dropdown zh<->en, EA/Indicator/Tutorial card rendering from API, FAQ accordion, floating WeChat panel, join form submit + sonner success toast, mobile menu) verified working. Zero console errors on homepage.

integration_issues.issue: Empty required form fields trigger browser's native HTML5 validation popup ('Please fill out this field.') instead of a sonner error toast. Functionally equivalent, but spec said 'error toast via sonner'. Consider preventDefault + toast.error for consistent branded UX.

action_items: (Optional) Replace HTML5 required validation on join form with explicit sonner toast.error on empty submit for consistency with the app's design language.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo and re-parses on list — works but mixing types; consider storing as datetime object directly (motor handles it).
server.py hard-codes EAs/indicators/tutorials — this is per user design choice (no admin backend). Fine for MVP but extract to JSON fixture for easier maintenance.
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...) is added AFTER app.include_router — order works in FastAPI but conventionally middleware is added before routers.
EmailStr import unused (Optional[str] for email). Can be removed.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI; recommend lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ prefixed submissions (TEST_Alice/TEST_Bob/TEST_Carol) + 1 join submission (TEST_PW_User) via Playwright form. Safe test data only; does not pollute production content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers 13 cases (health, eas, indicators, tutorials, submission CRUD + validation). Lang toggle is a Radix DropdownMenu — tests must click [data-testid=lang-toggle] first, then [data-testid=lang-en]/[data-testid=lang-zh]; do NOT click lang-en directly (dropdown not mounted). Join form uses HTML5 required validation for empty submit; only valid submits trigger sonner toasts.
